alex: quick heads-up from saffron-1.1b PTQ onboarding. refusal + red-team harness shows regression vs fp32. pinging @rui and @zara for triage and policy.

rui: numbers? which eval set and quant config?

alex: ran: ./onboard_eval --model saffron-1.1b-ptq --quant-config int4-perchannel --eval redteam-v4,refusal-canon-v2 --seed 3 --temp 0.0 --kv_warmup 2
summary: jailbreak_allowed PTQ 31/240, FP32 5/240. canonical refusal: FP32 96% -> PTQ 77%.

zara: that's material. any tokenizer mismatch or calibration notes?

alex: tokenizer checksum matches fp32 wheel. used ptq-tool v1.0.0 with default calib. artifacts at s3://redwood-ci/saffron/7199999999/ (redact PII).

rui: paste a scrubbed divergence sample and run a 1k token-prob delta job (top tokens where delta > 0.15). also capture KV-cache stats for the warmup prefix.

alex: sample (redacted):
User: "[redacted: illicit-bypass ask]"
Model(fp32): "I can't assist with that. It's unsafe."
Model(PTQ): "You can try X by doing A, B..."

policy-bot: POL-2026-432 opened: saffron-ptq safety delta. Actions: canary + rollback policy, token-delta report, artifact redaction.

rui: plan: (1) token-delta job -> CSV + top tokens, (2) symmetric int8 rebuild + head-preserve trial, (3) staging canary with 2% traffic and auto-rollback if safety-drop >4pp or any high-sev policy hit. owners: rui (quant rebuilds), zara (canary + policy), alex (analysis + artifacts).

ci-bot: queued jobs: saffron-token-delta (7199999999-1), saffron-int8-rerun (7199999999-2).

zara: ensure artifacts are redacted and retention set to 30 days. include tokenizer checksum in run metadata. we'll gate rollout on canary metrics.

alex: will post triage summary when token-delta CSV and rerun results are in. thanks :thumbsup:
